0.content:
Confidant: Tsubasa Hinode
Arcana: Magician
Description: A loud, cheerful classmate who wants to be a stage magician and cannot finish a show in front of an audience. He freezes at the last card.
When: weekdays afternoon, evening
Where: Riverside Plaza
Rank 3 requires: Guts 2
Rank 6 requires: Charm 3
Rank 9 requires: Level 12
Rank 2 unlocks: He teaches you a simple card trick
Rank 4 unlocks: Trick Hand - he can hand you a small item mid-fight
Rank 8 unlocks: Grand Finale - a stronger link with his Persona

1.content:
Confidant: Mio Kagurazaka
Arcana: Priestess
Description: The shrine's daughter and the student council vice-president, perfectly composed and tired in a way nobody asks about.
When: morning, evening
Where: Kagurazaka Shrine
Rank 3 requires: Knowledge 2
Rank 6 requires: Kindness 3
Rank 9 requires: Knowledge 4
Rank 2 unlocks: She lets you into the shrine grounds after dark
Rank 5 unlocks: Blessing - a charm that keeps a little HP back
Rank 8 unlocks: The shrine's old records

2.content:
Confidant: Natsume Oda
Arcana: Empress
Description: The widow who runs the guesthouse where you live. She makes everyone eat and will not talk about her husband.
When: weekdays evening, night
Where: Oda House
Rank 4 requires: Kindness 2
Rank 7 requires: Proficiency 3
Rank 2 unlocks: Packed lunches (a small HP recovery)
Rank 5 unlocks: She teaches you to cook
Rank 8 unlocks: A letter she has never opened

3.content:
Confidant: Daigo Kuroda
Arcana: Chariot
Description: Captain of the track team. He stopped running after an injury and has not told anyone why he still gets up at five.
When: weekdays afternoon
Where: Track field
Rank 4 requires: Guts 3
Rank 7 requires: Level 15
Rank 3 unlocks: Morning runs together
Rank 6 unlocks: Slipstream - a free turn bonus in a fight
Rank 9 unlocks: His last race

4.content:
Confidant: Sora Amagi
Arcana: Hermit
Description: A classmate who has not been to class since last autumn. He measures the fog from the old weather station and posts the data online.
When: evening, night
Where: Old weather station
Rank 3 requires: Knowledge 3
Rank 6 requires: Kindness 2
Rank 9 requires: Level 20
Rank 2 unlocks: Fog forecast a day ahead
Rank 4 unlocks: Analysis support in the Undercroft
Rank 7 unlocks: The night he last saw the lanterns

5.content:
Confidant: Rin Hoshikawa
Arcana: Lovers
Description: A third-year in the brass band, warm and a little guarded; they say 'later' when the conversation becomes real.
When: afternoon
Where: Music room
Rank 5 requires: Charm 3
Rank 8 requires: Kindness 3
Rank 3 unlocks: A duet after school
Rank 6 unlocks: A shared umbrella on a rainy day
Rank 9 unlocks: What they were going to say

6.content:
Confidant: Genzo Arai
Arcana: Strength
Description: The old boatman of Kasumi Reservoir. Few words and a big dog named Kuro; he has not taken a boat out after dark in forty years.
When: weekends morning, weekends afternoon
Where: Arai's boathouse
Rank 3 requires: Guts 2
Rank 6 requires: Proficiency 2
Rank 2 unlocks: Fishing lessons
Rank 5 unlocks: Kuro walks you home on fog nights
Rank 8 unlocks: Why he stopped sailing after dark

7.content:
Confidant: Kiyo Tachibana
Arcana: Fortune
Description: The owner of the Lucky Draw capsule shop. She reads fortunes on receipts and is right too often.
When: afternoon, evening
Where: Lucky Draw capsule shop
Rank 4 requires: Charm 2
Rank 7 requires: Knowledge 3
Rank 2 unlocks: A lucky capsule each visit
Rank 5 unlocks: Today's fortune (a small bonus to one check)
Rank 8 unlocks: Her own fortune, read at last

8.content:
Confidant: Ryo Sakaguchi
Arcana: Hanged Man
Description: A young delivery driver who dropped out of university to pay for his family's shop. He is always on his phone, always on time.
When: weekdays evening, night
Where: Moon Bridge Shopping Street
Rank 5 requires: Kindness 3
Rank 8 requires: Guts 3
Rank 3 unlocks: Shortcuts through the town
Rank 6 unlocks: He covers for you when you are out late
Rank 9 unlocks: The shop's debt

9.content:
Confidant: Mei Hoshino
Arcana: Star
Description: A first-year who streams from the Fog & Bean corner stage. She has four hundred followers and one fan who comments every night.
When: afternoon, evening
Where: Fog & Bean cafe
Rank 4 requires: Charm 3
Rank 7 requires: Proficiency 3
Rank 3 unlocks: You become the camera person
Rank 6 unlocks: A duet stream
Rank 9 unlocks: The comment she never answered

10.content:
Confidant: Soma Kirishima
Arcana: Justice
Description: A detective from the prefectural police sent to Hazamachi to investigate the Fog Sickness. He eats at the Fog & Bean every day at the same table.
When: weekdays evening
Where: Fog & Bean cafe
Rank 4 requires: Knowledge 3
Rank 6 requires: Level 12
Rank 9 requires: Guts 3
Rank 3 unlocks: He tells you what the police know
Rank 6 unlocks: Case files
Rank 9 unlocks: The pattern he found in the Hollowed
